programme.desc: Postarší svobodná dáma žijící v malé obci St. Mary Mead pomáhá svým přátelům a příbuzným řešit záhadné vraždy. Dolly Bantryová požádá svou dávnou přítelkyni, slečnu Marplovou, o pomoc, když se v knihovně jejího sídla Gossington Hall najde oběšená světlovlasá dívka, kterou nikdo nezná.

programme.title: Vražedné záhady slečny Fisherové - Hrozinky a mandle
programme.desc: Phryne Fisherová je na místě činu v knihkupectví, kde je nalezena mrtvola mladého muže. Je přesvědčená, že byl otráven.

programme.title: Vraždy pro slečnu Fisherovou - Vražda v přímém přenosu - Část 2
programme.desc: Peregrine Fisherová poskytla azyl svému bývalému příteli, který pracuje v televizi jako elektrikář. Kromě toho mu začne pomáhat, aby nebyl obviněn z vraždy zpěváka a tanečnice v populární televizní show. Nebude to však snadné, protože podezřelých je hodně...

programme.title: Slečna Marplová - Vražda na faře
programme.desc: Nikoho nepřekvapí, když je plukovník Protheroe nalezen zavražděný na místní faře. Vodítek je mnoho, a navíc se k vraždě přizná jak vdova po plukovníkovi, tak její milenec.

programme.title: Hercule Poirot - Dobrodružství claphamské kuchařky
programme.desc: Paní Toddová z Claphamu požádá Hercula Poirota o pomoc při pátrání po její zmizelé kuchařce. Ta si vzala jeden den volna, ale do práce se nevrátila a nezanechala ani žádnou zprávu. Tento na první pohled banální případ by sám o sobě jistě nebyl hoden velkého Poirota, kdyby se ovšem nezjistilo, že podnájemník paní Todové pracuje v bance, ze které bylo den před kuchařčiným zmizením uloupeno 90 000 liber. Poirot si dá obě události dohromady a případ zmizelé kuchařky jej začne náramně zajímat…

programme.title: Hercule Poirot - Vražda v Mews
programme.desc: Vrchní inspektor Japp požádá Poirota o pomoc při vyšetřování smrti mladé ženy, paní Allenové. Na místě činu Poirot záhy zjistí, že tělo mrtvé je sice naaranžováno, jako by šlo o sebevraždu, ale nalezená zbraň a další stopy dokazují, že paní Allenová byla zavražděna.Celá událost získá skandální nádech poté, co se zjistí, že zavražděná byla snoubenkou ambiciózního poslance. Zdá se, že klíčem k rozluštění vraždy bude nějaká událost z minulosti…

programme.title: Vraždy pro slečnu Fisherovou - Vražda v laboratoři - Část 1
programme.desc: Birdie marně čeká na svou přítelkyni Cecile, která pracuje ve vládní laboratoři na utajeném projektu. Když je nalezena mrtvá, začne celý tým pomáhat s vyšetřováním a Birdie všechny nabádá, aby si uvědomili, že jde o víc než o pouhé vyšetřování vraždy...

programme.title: Zločiny z vřesovišť - Tiché hlasy
programme.desc: Vyšetřovatelka Vera Stanhopeová se snaží vypátrat spojitost mezi dvěma případy utopení. První mrtvou je uznávaná sociální pracovnice a druhým utopeným je malé dítě, za jehož smrt byla shledána zodpovědnou jeho matka.

programme.title: Pan a Paní Smithovi
programme.desc: Na první pohled obyčejní manželé John a Jane Smithovi si pět (nebo šest) let užívají poklidného, až trochu nudného společného života. Pak se ale provalí pravda! Aniž by to o sobě navzájem věděli, oba jsou ve skutečnosti dobře placenými nájemnými zabijáky, kteří ale pracují pro konkurenční organizace. A teď zjišťují, že se navzájem stali svými příštími terči.

programme.title: Superžena
programme.desc: Šest chlapů - scenáristů dostalo za úkol napsat filmovou povídku na téma: Jak si představujete superženu? Tato nevyčerpatelná studnice ženského světa dostává prostřednictvím scénáristů nečekaně překvapivé zápletky a interpretace. Setkáváme se s ženami v různých situacích, které na první pohled nemají s představou ženy v superlativech nic společného, a povídky jsou o to překvapivější...

programme.title: Smrt v Šanghaji
programme.desc: Režisér Mikael Hafström (Pokoj 1408) uvádí velkolepý špionážní thriller Smrt v Šanghaji s Johnem Cusackem (Pokoj 1408) a světovými hvězdami Li Gong (Miami Vice, Gejša) a Kenem Watanabem (Dopisy z Iwo Jimy, Poslední samuraj) v hlavních rolích. Film ve stylu Casablanky se odehrává v týdnech před útokem na Pearl Harbor ve starobylém čínském městě, kde nic není, jak se zdá.

programme.title: Smrt v Šanghaji
programme.desc: Režisér Mikael Hafström (Pokoj 1408) uvádí velkolepý špionážní thriller Smrt v Šanghaji s Johnem Cusackem (Pokoj 1408) a světovými hvězdami Li Gong (Miami Vice, Gejša) a Kenem Watanabem (Dopisy z Iwo Jimy, Poslední samuraj) v hlavních rolích. Film ve stylu Casablanky se odehrává v týdnech před útokem na Pearl Harbor ve starobylém čínském městě, kde nic není, jak se zdá.

programme.title: Přijatelná oběť
programme.desc: Elizabeth „Libby“ Lammová je poradkyní ambiciózní a chladné političky Rachel Burkeové. Burkeová však vtahuje Libby stále hlouběji do bezohledného boje o moc a když na ni svede odpovědnost za vojenský zásah, který si vyžádá statisíce obětí, rozhodne se Libby rezignovat. Jenže pro někoho, kdo má důvěrné znalosti o tak vysoce postavené osobě, jako je Rachel Burkeová, se rezignace rovná rozsudku smrti.

programme.title: Vraždy v Oxfordu
programme.desc: Při předpremiéře představení ve studentském divadle v Oxfordu je zavražděn jeden z herců. Než stačí inspektor Lewis prorazit podivnou bariéru mlčení, dojde k další vraždě.

programme.title: Vražedné záhady slečny Fisherové - Hrozinky a mandle
programme.desc: Phryne Fisherová je na místě činu v knihkupectví, kde je nalezena mrtvola mladého muže. Je přesvědčená, že byl otráven.

programme.title: Slečna Marplová - Vražda na faře
programme.desc: Nikoho nepřekvapí, když je plukovník Protheroe nalezen zavražděný na místní faře. Vodítek je mnoho, a navíc se k vraždě přizná jak vdova po plukovníkovi, tak její milenec.

programme.title: Vražedné záhady slečny Fisherové - Ruddigore
programme.desc: Duch herečky se objeví po dvaceti letech od její sebevraždy, aby strašil v divadle. Na začátku představení Ruddigore Gilberta a Sullivana zemře jeden z herců na jevišti.

programme.title: Vraždy pro slečnu Fisherovou - Vražda v laboratoři - Část 1
programme.desc: Birdie marně čeká na svou přítelkyni Cecile, která pracuje ve vládní laboratoři na utajeném projektu. Když je nalezena mrtvá, začne celý tým pomáhat s vyšetřováním a Birdie všechny nabádá, aby si uvědomili, že jde o víc než o pouhé vyšetřování vraždy...

programme.title: Slečna Marplová - Vlak z Paddingtonu
programme.desc: Slečna Marplová vyšetřuje na sídle bohaté rodiny Crackenthorpových. Přítel, který u nich byl na návštěvě, byl totiž svědkem brutální vraždy, k níž došlo v projíždějícím vlaku, a rodina je přesvědčena, že je uškrcené tělo ukryto na jejich pozemku.

programme.title: Hercule Poirot - Únos Johnnieho Waverlyho
programme.desc: Hercule Poirot je povolán bohatým majitelem pozemků Marcusem Waverlym, aby zajistil bezpečnost jeho tříletého syna Johnnieho, kterému někdo vyhrožuje únosem, pokud Waverly nesloží vyděračům 50 000 liber. Do venkovského domu Waverlyů se spolu s Poirotem dostaví i inspektor Japp se svými lidmi, ale přes tuto zvýšenou ostrahu je malý Johnnie unesen. Poirot má podezření, že únoscem je někdo z chlapcova blízkého okolí - možná dokonce z rodiny…

programme.title: Hercule Poirot - Dvacet čtyři černých kosů
programme.desc: Hercule Poirot obědvá ve své oblíbené londýnské restauraci. Od servírky se dozvídá o podivné změně v chování jednoho z pravidelných hostů: malíř Henry Gascoine, který si u nich vždy v úterý a ve čtvrtek dává své menu, se náhle začal objevovat v jiné dny a objednává si jídlo, kterého by se dřív ani nedotkl. Poirota tato záležitost velice zaujme a druhý den bedlivě sleduje malířovo chování. Další den přinesou noviny zprávu o Henryho tragické smrti.

programme.title: Vraždy pro slečnu Fisherovou - Vražda v laboratoři - Část 2
programme.desc: Birdie marně čeká na svou přítelkyni Cecile, která pracuje ve vládní laboratoři na utajeném projektu. Když je nalezena mrtvá, začne celý tým pomáhat s vyšetřováním a Birdie všechny nabádá, aby si uvědomili, že jde o víc než o pouhé vyšetřování vraždy...

programme.title: Zločiny z vřesovišť - Milosrdný samaritán
programme.desc: Mladý muž je nalezen mrtvý s heroinem v krvi a kradenou kreditní kartou v peněžence. Teprve když Vera odhalí podrobnosti ze života jeho matky, začne se rýsovat motiv vraždy.

programme.title: Vražda mezi přáteli
programme.desc: Legendární televizní hvězda řeší na svém venkovském sídle záhadu vraždy.

programme.title: Zlaté rybky
programme.desc: Policie přijíždí do bytu manželů Nejtkových, kde najdou mrtvou ženu, Evu Nejtkovou, a jejího zraněného manžela Zdeňka v bezvědomí, který se podle všeho postřelil brokovnicí. Vyšetřování se ujímá kapitán Hora, který s kolegy začíná zajišťovat stopy, které by pomohly případ objasnit. Zajímavá je pro Horu například skutečnost, že vrah, který zabil ženu úderem do hlavy a rozbil přitom velké akvárium, pečlivě posbíral zlaté rybičky a umístil je do malého akvária.

programme.title: Motel
programme.desc: Jack, tvrdý chlapík a chronický smolař, má dokončit jednoduchý, ale neobvyklý úkol. Přinést zločineckému bossovi, který si ho najal, tajemnou černou tašku.

programme.title: Nahota na prodej
programme.desc: Krátce po sametové revoluci se z kdekoho stává podnikatel. Obory podnikání se různí. Ať už jsou to legální formy, nebo naopak organizovaný zločin. Mladá studentka Nancy přijíždí do Prahy na stáž. Má české kořeny, a proto si zvolila Prahu. Společně s novinářem Egonem a bývalým policistou, nyní soukromým detektivem Poldou, pátrají po unesené šestnáctileté dívce. Její otec je zoufalý, ani policie mu nedokáže pomoci.

programme.title: Lilly Schönauer: Překážky lásky
programme.desc: Mladá módní návrhářka Laura se vznáší v sedmém nebi. Poté, co u svého přítele Alexandra našla zásnubní prsten, si je jistá, že chce společnou návštěvu u rodičů využít k tomu, aby ji oficiálně požádal o ruku. Rodinný víkend se však nevyvíjí dobře. Alexandrova sebevědomá matka dává Lauře najevo, že pro jejího syna není dost dobrá. Aby toho nebylo málo, objeví se i jeho bývalá přítelkyně Susanne, která udělá vše pro to, aby Alexandra získala zpět.

programme.title: Láska na čtyřech tlapkách
programme.desc: Organizátorka společenských akcí Lilly si vezme do dočasné péče rozpustilého psa, jehož nezkrotné kousky jí převrátí život vzhůru nohama. Při přípravách prestižního galavečera spolupracuje s trenérem psů Shanem, který jí pomůže znovu objevit lásku v jejím životě.

programme.title: S láskou, Tvá sladce solená
programme.desc: Alison je uznávaná gastronomická kritička Chicago Tribune, která si zakládá na absolutní anonymitě, aby restaurace hodnotila z pohledu běžného zákazníka. Když se ale její nelítostná recenze nově otevřené restaurace nečekaně stane virálním hitem, šéfredaktor ji přiměje napravit škody. Alison proto nastoupí v utajení jako pomocná kuchařka do týmu šéfkuchaře, kterého ve své recenzi nemilosrdně zkritizovala.

programme.title: Smrt černého krále
programme.desc: Praha třicátých let minulého století. Do nabité tramvaje nastupuje mladá hezká dívka. Rázem upoutá pozornost mládence, který nejen oceňuje dívčin půvab, ale hlavně se snaží nenápadně ukrást její kabelku. A tak se seznamujeme s jednou z hlavních postav filmu, s podvodníkem, kapsářem a vůbec podivnou existencí Josefem Kořínkem alias Pépim. Kromě něj je příběh zalidněn dalšími postavičkami z pražské periferie.

programme.title: Zločiny z vřesovišť - Past na vránu
programme.desc: V areálu přírodní rezervace se plánuje výstavba lomu, proto je zde nutné provést ekologický průzkum. Kvůli němu se do odlehlého domku v kopcích nastěhovala přírodovědkyně Anne Preeceová. Vzápětí je ovšem ve stodole objeveno tělo zavražděné majitelky domku a přilehlé farmy. Mohla její smrt souviset s připravovanou výstavbou? Vyšetřování se ještě nestačí ani pořádně rozběhnout a následuje další vražda.

programme.title: Zločiny z vřesovišť - Malý Lazar
programme.desc: Jedenáctiletý Adam unikl smrti jen o vlásek. Vrah, který surově utloukl jeho matku Margaret, chlapce zahnal do ledové řeky a v domnění, že je mrtev, z místa činu uprchl. Inspektorka Stanhopeová ale tuší, že nebude trvat dlouho, než zjistí svůj omyl a pokusí se jediného svědka brutální vraždy umlčet. Kdo byla Margaret Wildeová, která žila tak, aby po sobě a synovi zanechala co nejméně stop? Z koho měla takový strach? A proč Adam říká, že viděl pávy, když na místě činu rozhodně nebyli?

programme.title: Hercule Poirot - Hra na vraždu
programme.desc: Na Ariadnu Oliverovou se obrátil zámožný pan George Stubbs, aby pro něj a hosty pobývající na jeho honosném sídle v Devonshiru zorganizovala fiktivní hon na vraha. Jak se však blíží den hry, cítí, že něco není v pořádku. Jako by neměla vše plně pod kontrolou, ale byla pouhou loutkou v něčích rukách. Její obavy se ukážou jako opodstatněné, když dojde ke skutečné vraždě. Někdo neviditelný postrkoval figurky a je na Poirotovi, aby svým důvtipem odhalil toho, kdo předem určil úlohy ve hře na smrt.

programme.title: Hercule Poirot - Herkulovské úkoly pro Hercula Poirota
programme.desc: Poirot ve spolupráci s policií připraví na večírku společenské smetánky past na proslulého lupiče Marascauda. Jako návnada slouží obraz Zabití hydry, jeden z celého cyklu maleb, zobrazujících jednotlivé Herkulovy úkoly, na něž se Marascaud v posledních měsících zaměřil. Celá akce však končí fiaskem. Nejenže je dotyčný obraz ukraden, během loupeže je navíc surově zavražděna hostitelka. Geniální detektiv upadá do vleklé deprese, z níž mu může pomoci jen další případ.

programme.title: Hercule Poirot - Opona - Poirotův poslední případ
programme.desc: Kapitán Hastings se po dlouhých letech vrací na zámek Styles, kde před lety s Poirotem vyřešili svůj první společný případ. Nyní se opět jedná o vraždu, vlastně o několik vražd, páchaných tak rafinovaně a skrytě, že sám velký detektiv v jednu chvíli říká, že se s tak obratným zločincem dosud nesetkal. Hastings, kromě upřímné snahy pomoci svému churavějícímu příteli v nesnadném pátrání, musí také řešit komplikovaný vztah k dceři Judith, která na zámku rovněž pobývá.

programme.title: Sběratel andělů
programme.desc: "The Angel Maker" je psychologický kriminální thriller, který sleduje Lauru, vyšetřovatelku kybernetických zločinů, která pronásleduje brutálního sériového vraha.

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Otec Jeff přijede s dcerou Becky a přítelkyní na víkend k jezeru. Jenomže výlet se změní v boj o život, když k nim domů vtrhnou vězni na útěku, vedeni nemilosrdným Dominickem.

programme.title: Hon
programme.desc: Učitel po rozvodu žije osamělým životem a bojuje o opatrovnictví svého syna. Jeho pochmurný život se začíná pomalu ubírat k lepšímu, ale stačí jedna malá lež a vše začne brát za své.

programme.title: Talea
programme.desc: Summertime. Everybody is excited to go on vacation to Italy. Everybody but Jasmin. Jasmin is yearning something. She wants to be with Eva, her mother, from whom she had to live seperately for a long time. For weeks, Jasmin is trying to get close to Eva. She does not give up, even if she's rejected. After an argument, Jasmin runs away from her fosterhome and convinces Eva to leave the city together and go on a trip. The two get closer -- sometimes as friends, sometimes as mother and daughter.

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: The tranquility of a small town is marred only by sheriff Tod Shaw's unsuccessful courtship of widow Ellen Benson, a pacifist who can't abide guns and those who use them. But violence descends on Ellen's household willy-nilly when the U.S. President passes through town... and slightly psycho hired assassin John Baron finds the Benson home ideal for an ambush.

programme.title: Manos: The hands of fate - The hands of fate
programme.desc: A family gets lost on the road and stumbles upon a hidden, underground, devil-worshiping cult led by the fearsome Master and his servant Torgo.

programme.title: Parole, Inc.
programme.desc: Parole officers fight gangsters trying to break into system.

programme.title: Silver On The Sage
programme.desc: Hoppy goes undercover as a gambler from the East when Bar 20 cattle are stolen by unknown rustlers. Brennan/Talbot are twin brothers (one a casino owner, the other a rancher) and Hoppy believes they provide alibis for each other while one is out committing crimes. Hoppy gets a job in the casino to learn more but is exposed when a gambling gunslinger notices him.

programme.title: Indian
programme.desc: Dreaming about the Wild West in the 1970s in Eastern Europe is not enough…

programme.title: Stingaree
programme.desc: A young lady named Hilda who works as a servant for the wealthy Clarksons, sheep farmers, and dreams of being a great singer. An upcoming visit by Sir Julian, a famous composer arriving from London, drives jealous Mrs. Clarkson (an interfering biddy who fancies she can sing - but can't) to send away Hilda, so he doesn't hear Hilda has a good voice.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: A trucker framed for murder breaks out of jail, takes a young woman hostage, and enters her sports car in cross-border road race hoping to get to Mexico before the police catch him.

programme.title: Operation Bottleneck
programme.desc: WW II Burma...Six paratroopers undertake an extremely dangerous mission against the Japanese. It will ultimately cost them their lives, except for one "lucky" survivor.

programme.title: The Frontiersman
programme.desc: The local school is causing Hoppy problems. First Bar 20 cattle are stolen when Hoppy investigates a problem there. Then the new teacher arrives and disrupts the routine of the Bar 20 hands. Later with the Bar 20 hands at graduation, the rustlers are poised to strike again. But there is dissension among them and this will lead to the break that Hoppy needs.

programme.title: Please Murder Me!
programme.desc: A lawyer tries to exact justice on a woman he defended in court -- a woman whom he found out was guilty after getting her off.

programme.title: Our Daily Bread
programme.desc: John and Mary Sims are city-dwellers hit hard by the financial fist of The Depression. Driven by bravery (and sheer desperation) they flee to the country and, with the help of other workers, set up a farming community - a socialist mini-society. The newborn community suffers many hardships - drought, vicious raccoons and the long arm of the law - but ultimately pull together to reach a bread-based Utopia.

programme.title: The Passionate Plumber
programme.desc: Paris plumber Elmer Tuttle is enlisted by socialite Patricia Alden to help make her lover Tony Lagorce jealous. With the help of his friend Julius J. McCracken and through the high society contacts he has made through Patricia, Elmer hopes to find financing for his latest invention, a pistol with a range-finding light. Comic complications ensue when Elmer's effort to interest a military leader is misconstrued as an assassination attempt.

programme.title: Nabonga
programme.desc: When a treasure hunter seeks a downed airplane in the jungles of Africa, he encounters one of the passenger's young daughter, now fully grown, and with a gorilla protector.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's a bloodthirsty plant, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: Hell's House
programme.desc: Jimmy idolizes bootlegger Matt, and when he refuses to implicate his friend, he is sent to reform school. He befriends Shorty, a boy with a heart condition, and escapes to let the world know about the brutal conditions.

programme.title: Prelude to Murder
programme.desc: A convicted thief in Dartmoor prison hides the location of the stolen Bank of England printing plates inside three music boxes. When the innocent purchasers of the boxes start to be murdered, Holmes and Watson investigate.

programme.title: Mr Wong - Doomed To Die
programme.desc: Shipping magnate Cyrus Wentworth, downcast over a disaster to his ocean liner 'Wentworth Castle' (carrying, oddly enough, an illicit shipment of Chinese bonds) is shot in his office at the very moment of kicking out his daughter's fiance Dick Fleming. Of course, Captain Street arrests Dick, but reporter Bobbie Logan, the attractive thorn in Street's side, is so convinced he's wrong that she enlists the help of detective James Lee Wong to find the real killer.

programme.title: La Deuxieme
programme.desc: Jean Barreau leads a spiritual commune on the countryside with the promise of a second life. When their doubles arrive at the house, his followers learn that Jean meant this promise quite literally. However, not everybody is as easily swayed by their capricious leader, who eventually starts to question his own beliefs.

programme.title: She Should'A Said No
programme.desc: A chorus girl's career is ruined and her brother is driven to suicide when she starts smoking marijuana.

programme.title: The Mystery of Mr. Wong
programme.desc: Detective James Lee Wong must find the "Eye of the Daughter of the Moon," a priceless but cursed sapphire stolen in China and smuggled to America. His search takes him into the heart of Chinatown and to the dreaded "House of Hate" to find the deadly gem before it can kill again.

programme.title: Behind Green Lights
programme.desc: An unscrupulous private investigator with a penchant for blackmail is found dead in a car and the leading suspect is Janet Bradley, the daughter of a mayoral candidate. With the election just weeks away, shady and ruthless individuals muscle the medical officer into switching the corpse with another body. Lieutenant Sam Carson, one of the few good apples in the bunch must find a way to get to the bottom of it all.

programme.title: Behind Green Lights
programme.desc: An unscrupulous private investigator with a penchant for blackmail is found dead in a car and the leading suspect is Janet Bradley, the daughter of a mayoral candidate. With the election just weeks away, shady and ruthless individuals muscle the medical officer into switching the corpse with another body. Lieutenant Sam Carson, one of the few good apples in the bunch must find a way to get to the bottom of it all.

programme.title: Born To Be Wild
programme.desc: Truck drivers Steve Hackett and Bill Purvis are fired for ignoring company rules, then suddenly hired for a mysterious delivery to Arrowhead with a $1,000 bonus. Told they are hauling lettuce, they soon discover the cargo is dynamite after an encounter with striking farm workers. Joined by Mary Stevens and her dog Butch, they uncover a plot by corrupt real‑estate operators to sabotage a dam, ruin local farmers, and seize their land.

programme.title: Captain Calamity
programme.desc: A South Seas skipper fights off thieves and pirates who are after a lost treasure.

programme.title: The Navigator
programme.desc: The wealthy and impulsive Rollo Treadway decides to propose to his beautiful socialite neighbor, Betsy O'Brien. Although Betsy turns Rollo down, he still opts to go on the cruise that he intended as their honeymoon.

programme.title: The Monster Maker
programme.desc: Mad scientist injects his enemies with acromegaly virus, causing them to become hideously deformed.

programme.title: The Railrodder
programme.desc: After reading an newspaper advertisement in the London Times about touring Canada, an elderly Englishman decides to do just that. Following his long walk across the Atlantic Ocean, Keaton travels along the Canadian National Railway tracks on a railway motorcar (speeder), performing a few stunts reminiscent of those in his younger days.

programme.title: Voyage to the Prehistoric Planet
programme.desc: In 2020, after the colonization of the moon, the spaceships Vega, Sirius and Capella are launched from Lunar Station 7.

programme.title: Parlor, Bedroom And Bath
programme.desc: Jeffrey Haywood wants to marry to Virginia Embrey. However, Virginia refused to marry unless her older sister, the hard-to-please Angelica gets married first. Angelica, in turn, finds every man she knows too dull and predictable, and for this reason prefers to stay single. Jeff then tries to make Angelica interested in the mild-mannered and timid Reggie Irving passing him off as a notorious playboy to intrigue her.

programme.title: New Voices in an Old Flower
programme.desc: "It was an era, it was the start of a new vision" says Amha Eshete, the first Ethiopian music producer back in the Golden Age, the days of Swingin' Addis. The album releases that have crossed Ethiopian borders are mainly recordings from the 50's to the 80's, however, the contemporary music scene from Addis remains, bar a few exceptions, unknown to the rest of the world. Is Addis still swinging as it used to?

programme.title: Bluebeard
programme.desc: Young female models are being strangled. Will law enforcement be able to stop the crime wave before more women become victims?

programme.title: The Lady Refuses
programme.desc: A wealthy London nobleman hires a pretty but poor young woman to distract his playboy son from marrying a golddigger. Complications ensue when the girl and the father begin to fall for each other, and things get even more complicated when the son declares his love for her, too.

programme.title: Dead Men Walk
programme.desc: The twin of a kindly small-town physician returns from the grave for vengeance against his brother, who secretly killed him because the twin served Satan.

programme.title: Corpse Vanishes
programme.desc: A scientist, aided by an old hag and her two sons, kills virginal brides, steals their bodies, and extracts gland fluid to keep his ancient wife alive and young.

programme.title: A Shriek in the Night
programme.desc: Rival newspaper reporters Pat Morgan and Ted Rand find themselves unraveling the mystery behind the death of a millionaire philanthropist who fell from his penthouse balcony. When it is discovered that the plunge was not an accident, the building's residents come under suspicion. Soon, the body count begins to mount as three more murders occur by strangulation.

programme.title: The Murder in the Museum
programme.desc: When a city councilman is murdered while investigating allegations of drug dealing going on a a somewhat disreputable sideshow, the daughter of the chief suspect teams up with a newspaper reporter to find the real killer.

programme.title: Tokyo Twilight
programme.desc: Two sisters find out the existence of their long-lost mother, but the younger cannot take the truth of being abandoned as a child.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Parysia is the rage of Paris. She has a daughter, secretly engaged to Andre, and the boy's aristocratic father objects to the alliance because of Margaret's mother being a revue artist. Director Ewald Andre Dupont took almost a year to make Moulin Rouge at a production cost of $500,000, a huge amount for 1928.

programme.title: 31 Hours
programme.desc: Stefan is an overworked surgeon who's just worked a thirty-one-hour shift. A last minute patient comes in and, as he is the only surgeon available, he goes in for one last operation before going home. Things do not go as planned though, and he loses the patient on the operating table. Starts a saga of deontological issues, where the corrupted Romanian health system comes under close scrutiny.

programme.title: Private Buckaroo
programme.desc: A rebellious young inductee has trouble toeing the line until he meets a retired officer's lovely daughter. James and his band are also drafted and decide to perk up their camp by putting on a big show.

programme.title: College
programme.desc: Ronald's high-school valedictory address praises books and condemns sports. His girlfriend Mary condemns his attitude. Fearing to lose her to rival Jeff, he decides to go to college and pay more attentions to sports.

programme.title: A Bucket of Blood
programme.desc: A dim-witted busboy finds acclaim as an artist for a plaster-covered dead cat that is mistaken as a skillful statuette. The desire for more praise soon leads to an increasingly deadly series of works.

programme.title: Boots And Saddles
programme.desc: Young Englishman inherits ranch which he wants to sell, but Gene's gonna turn him into a real westerner instead. When new owner Spud arrives from England, Autry convinces him not to sell the ranch but to raise horses for the Army. When both Autry's and Neale's bids are the same, the Colonel calls for a race to decide the winner. But that night Neale has Autry's stable burned.

programme.title: Boots And Saddles
programme.desc: Young Englishman inherits ranch which he wants to sell, but Gene's gonna turn him into a real westerner instead. When new owner Spud arrives from England, Autry convinces him not to sell the ranch but to raise horses for the Army. When both Autry's and Neale's bids are the same, the Colonel calls for a race to decide the winner. But that night Neale has Autry's stable burned.

programme.title: Till The Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Songwriter and Broadway pioneer Jerome Kern is unable to find immediate success in the U.S. He sought recognition abroad. He journeyed to England where his dreams of success became real and where he met his future wife Eva Leale.

programme.title: A Woman's Life
programme.desc: A woman remember's her own marriage when dealing with the love life of her son.

programme.title: King Of The Zombies
programme.desc: During World War II, a small plane somewhere over the Caribbean runs low on fuel and is blown off course by a storm. Guided by a faint radio signal, they crash-land on an island. The passenger, his manservant and the pilot take refuge in a mansion owned by a doctor. The quick-witted yet easily-frightened manservant soon becomes convinced the mansion is haunted by zombies and ghosts.

programme.title: Career Girl
programme.desc: Joan Terry, a girl from the country wants to become a Broadway Star, but this proves to be not so easy.

programme.title: Club Paradise
programme.desc: A naive young girl, looking to escape from a bad family situation, falls in love with a man who turns out to be a cad, and leads her down the road to ruin.

programme.title: Sherlock - Woman In Green
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes investigates when young women around London turn up murdered, each with a finger severed. Scotland Yard suspects a madman, but Holmes believes the killings to be part of a diabolical plot.

programme.title: Mr Wong - The Fatal Hour
programme.desc: When a police officer is murdered, Captain Street looks to Mr. Wong to catch the killer. Prime Suspect: Frank Belden Jr., whose father is a businessman well known for both his success and dishonesty. Mr. Wong faces increasing danger and is nearly executed himself as the investigation develops in treachery and complexity. As Mr. Wong follows the trail of dead bodies, he uncovers a jewel smuggling ring on the San Francisco waterfront and a case much larger than the death of a police officer.

programme.title: Hitler - Beast Of Berlin
programme.desc: Hans Memling, a young intellectual, patriotic German, is secretly opposed to the Nazi regime. With the aid of Gustav Schultz, Father Pommer, Anna Wahl and others, he is gleaning accurate information from foreign radio broadcasts and distributing it through Germany with an underground-press operation.

programme.title: Badge of Honor
programme.desc: Bob Gordon comes from a rich background but wants make it on his own. He dreams of becoming a newspaper reporter and he eventually gets his chance.

programme.title: Renegade Girl
programme.desc: Ann Shelby, whose family is allied with the notorious William Quantrill, turns outlaw to revenge herself on a renegade Indian who killed her brother.

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Due to a bet drunk Gene almost forces Majesty to marry him, then escapes after brawling with sheriff Tom. Majesty buys a ranch, needs Gene's help and finds him in a drunken stupor in Mexico. He vows to stay sober and fights crooked Tom.

programme.title: It's A Joke, Son!
programme.desc: Claghorn gets into some financial difficulties and is forced by a machine-political gang to enter a race for state senator against his wife (Una Merkel) who appears to have a good chance to beat the political hack backed by the machine. Claghorn is in to siphon votes and ensure his wife's opponent will win and is expected to run a campaign that will defeat himself and his wife. But, he runs to win and the machine's henchies abduct him.

programme.title: Santa Fe Marshall
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Hopalong Cassidy is called when a town becomes overrun with bad guys. Disguised as a member of a medicine show, Hoppy discovers that the ringleader is none other than sweet li'l ol' Ma Burton.

programme.title: The Black Raven
programme.desc: A group of strangers are brought together in an old, dark house and must contend with two murders and $50,000 in stolen money.

programme.title: Mclintock!
programme.desc: Ageing, wealthy, rancher and self-made man, George Washington McLintock is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife—who left him two years previously—suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in George; she wants custody of their daughter.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: Buck Colins heads a group of local ranchers who are trying to prevent the railroad from completing its line through their property. Till now they have been able to charge tolls on herds passing through. Hoppy goes undercover to expose them.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Peril
programme.desc: Drummond's wedding with Phyllis is interrupted when the inspector guarding their gifts is killed. He tries to trace the killers and uncovers the mystery of diamond counterfeiters.

programme.title: The Terror of Tiny Town
programme.desc: Using a conventional Western story with an all dwarf cast, the filmmakers were able to showcase gags such as cowboys entering the local saloon by walking under the swinging doors, and pint-sized cowboys galloping around on Shetland ponies while roping calves.

programme.title: La Via Degli Angeli
programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

programme.title: La Via Degli Angeli
programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

programme.title: Life With Father
programme.desc: A financier from New York rules his numerous family, consisting of his wife and his four sons, with the meticulousness of a bookkeeper.

programme.title: Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: Love, marriage and heartache in paris after the war.

programme.title: Black Dragons
programme.desc: A cabal of American industrialists, all fifth-columnists intent on sabotaging the war effort, are methodically murdered by the malevolent Monsieur Colomb.

programme.title: Dangerous Passage
programme.desc: Joe Beck leaves Central America so that he can return to Texas and collect a large inheritance, but he picks a dangerous ship on which to travel.

programme.title: The Phantom of 42nd Street
programme.desc: A theatre critic (Dave O'Brien) teams up with a cop (Jack Mulhall) to investigate the murder of a Broadway actor.

programme.title: Revenge Of The Zombies
programme.desc: When Dr. Von Altermann's wife Lila dies mysteriously at his spooky mansion her relations suspect murder. They also suspect the doctor is turning her into a zombie, to join the army of living dead he hopes to devote to the Nazi cause. However, Lila, though dead, has developed a will of her own.

programme.title: La Via Degli Angeli
programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

programme.title: The Hoodlum
programme.desc: Vincent Lubeck is a vicious ex-convict. His criminal activities are despised by his family, but he uses and abuses them in the course of his crimes. Eventually his own brother must stand up to him

programme.title: The Inner Circle
programme.desc: A private detective finds himself with a perfect new secretary. But after a notorious gossip columnist turns up murdered, she may prove too good to be true.

programme.title: Game Show Dynamos
programme.desc: Bernard and Claire Boiko won enough money on TV game shows to escape debt and rebuild their lives, appearing on national television 28 times from the 1950s to the 1990s. Their daughter Patricia blends clips from 10 game shows with vintage footage, motion graphics, and music to create an intimate portrait of her quirky parents.

programme.title: Toll Bar
programme.desc: Rauan works at a parking lot in a prestigious residential area. Aidar passes him daily in his luxurious car. The auto belongs to his father, who works in the oil business. Rauan and Aidar are both determined to build their own lives themselves. They live in the same city, their paths cross in the same yard, but there is an abyss between them. programme.title: Race of Life - The Race Underfoot
programme.desc: Insects may be small, but their survival strategies are fierce. They thrive in diverse environments thanks to their exoskeletons, which protect against impact, chemicals, and water. Wings help them escape danger or seek food and mates. Dragonflies hover and dart after prey, monarchs undergo stunning metamorphosis, and praying mantises blend into greenery before striking. Social insects like ants and bees live in colonies.

programme.title: Race of Life - The Race of Life After the Dark
programme.desc: Finally for this series, we are exploring the world of nocturnal animals—creatures adapted to thrive in darkness. Escaping predators, avoiding heat, and sharing resources, they emerge as night falls. Join porcupines, raccoons, mice, cats, foxes, and more on their nightly journey. From raccoons with sensitive touch to mice surviving in teams, each is a master of the night. Across continents, these animals—like the fruit-loving porcupine—showcase fear, excitement, and survival in the shadows.

programme.title: On the Cities’ Rooftops - Paris
programme.desc: How is life on the city’s roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world’s rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey - Mexico. Mérida
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help!

programme.title: Blue World - Tiger Shark as a Camera Operator + Florida Cave Diving
programme.desc: Jonathan joins an expedition to recruit a new Blue World camera operator in the form of a 1,000 pound Tiger shark! Working with experienced shark handlers, he puts a camera on the dorsal fin of the shark to see what it can film all by itself. But will Jonathan get his camera back? Next, he joins an experienced cave diver to explore a famous underwater cave in Northern Florida (USA).

programme.title: Blue World - Cave Training in the Bahamas
programme.desc: Cave diving is the most difficult and dangerous type of diving, so the training to become a certified cave diver is arduous. This episode documents Jonathan’s actual cave training in the Bahamas and follows him as he learns how to dive safely in the overhead environment of a cave in an attempt to earn his full cave diver certification.

programme.title: Quirky Science - Episode 10
programme.desc: Early computers include the Antikythera device and Babbage’s engines, though his designs were ahead of their time. WWII accelerated the need for powerful calculators. Early machines were massive but weak. The invention of the transistor in the 1950s replaced bulky vacuum tubes, enabling personal computers. Today, supercomputers help design planes, buildings—even target genes. Computers are evolving fast—what’s next?

programme.title: Quirky Science - Episode 11
programme.desc: Paper wasn’t always easy to make or use. Early writing appeared on cave walls, bamboo, and papyrus. True paper was credited to Cai Lun in 105 AD. It was once expensive, but after the Black Death, cloth scraps made it cheaper. Pens evolved too—from messy feathers to the ballpoint. Today, paper contributes heavily to pollution—about 10% of greenhouse gases. The future? E-paper: the digital alternative to traditional paper.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That! - Swiss army knife, Cup of Joe, hamburger
programme.desc: Coca Cola, Slinky, Frisbee If you ever go camping there is one thing you do not want to leave home without, the swiss army knife! We’ll explain how it evolved into the most famous knife in the world and how the company’s name got “Cut” together! And where did the term "cup of Joe" come from as well as the word java? And we all love a juicy hamburger, so where did these chopped meat patties come from?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That! - Almond milk, scapegoat, buffalo wings
programme.desc: Coca Cola, Slinky, Frisbee Learn how almond nuts get transformed into “milk.” And why are movie trailers shown at the beginning of the film? We'll keep your attention so you'll want to stick around for the answer. And learn how detergents make your clothes seem brighter and whiter.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space - Space Walk, Oort Cloud, Mercury, Space Suit, Star Chart, Pluto
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: New Frontier - Stars Above
programme.desc: Stars are a bit like human beings. They can be warm or cold, they come in all kinds of shapes and sizes... and, let’s face it, they can be dim or bright. And recent discoveries suggest that the number of stars in our galaxy alone, the Milky Way, may exceed 200 billion. Just what are these citizens of the night sky?

programme.title: New Frontier - The Dark Side
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much - and certainly not nearly enough - about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it’s little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures - Episode 2
programme.desc: It’s the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering.

programme.title: Wonder - Color
programme.desc: Chromatic adaptation lets humans perceive consistent colors despite changing light. Some animals change color using chromatophores—for camouflage or signaling. Pink isn’t a real wavelength; our brains create it by blending light. Blue is rare in nature but appears through structural features in feathers and wings. Snow camouflage helps animals blend into winter landscapes using shades of white and gray.

programme.title: Wonder - Problems
programme.desc: The Monty Hall Problem shows switching choices boosts winning odds. The Birthday Problem reveals how just 23 people can have a 50% chance of shared birthdays due to multiple pairings. Gambler’s Ruin proves that in a fair game, the smaller bankroll loses over time. The Infinite Hotel Paradox explores the strange logic of infinity. The Locker Riddle uses factorization to reveal why only lockers with perfect square numbers stay open.

programme.title: Everyday Elements - Helium, Tin, Calcium, Palladium, Lead
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.desc: Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia - the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature - the weedy sea dragon - a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin - the Burrunan Dolphins.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears - Episode 6
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson.

programme.title: Animal Embassy - Birdman of Loro Parque
programme.desc: Rafa, the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque’, proudly leads the Foundation’s ornithological work, surrounded daily by parrots, puffins, and penguins. Meanwhile, Inaki faces a challenge: training Sue-Anne the anteater. Armed with vanilla yoghurt and patience, he’s hoping charm wins over stubbornness. Will she cooperate or snub his efforts?

programme.title: Animal Embassy - Gorilla with a Sore Foot
programme.desc: Ubongo the gorilla has a foot injury, and treating a 400-pound patient takes serious skill. Meanwhile, Ester’s team unveils a coral farm—less cuddly, but just as vital. And in the summer heat, Hugo the sloth cools off with a slow-motion shower. From veterinary challenges to marine innovation and quirky animal moments, Loro Parque never stops surprising.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend - Happy Few
programme.desc: The First World War: soldiers from at least 20 countries were plunged in the hell of trenches and caught under a deluge of bombs. A century later, archaeologists help bring to light the daily life of the soldiers fighting on the French Eastern Front and reveal unexpected aspects of life on the front.

programme.title: European Islands - La Gomera
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures - Season 2 - The Dude Ranches of Arizona
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones - Biggest
programme.desc: The colossal elephant. The lush tropical forests of Asia hold within them some of nature's mightiest creatures.Each of these silent footsteps carries with it the immense weight of the world's largest land mammal. The intimidating birds with soaring grace and aerial prowess, birds dominate our skies. To remain the undisputed pioneers of the air most bird species are feather light and relatively small.

programme.title: Wild Ones - Camouflage
programme.desc: Some animals will never be inconspicuous, others blend so perfectly with their surroundings that they can move through them without detection. Camouflaged cats - for many of the cats of Africa, camouflage is key to survival. From the spots of the cheetah, the rosettes of the leopard and the stripes and dots of the serval, these cats have evolved to merge with their habitat. Hidden Lizards - Regal horned lizards vanish into Arizona’s deserts, feeding mostly on ants.

programme.title: The Blue Realm - Giants of San Benedicto
programme.desc: Giants of San Benedicto features Dr. Robert Rubin and his ground-breaking research of giant Mantas. You'll travel to the remote Socorro Islands off Mexico's Pacific coast and see breath-taking encounters with enormous manta rays. You're sure to love these majestic giants as you see how they invite human contact, and encourage certain divers to ride them.

programme.title: Sarah Shark - Episode 3
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life - Underwater Predators
programme.desc: Most sea creatures are predators, from tiny fish to giant squid. Built to hunt and survive, they’ve evolved into efficient underwater war machines. Stonefish lie in wait, disguised, while sharks, barracuda, and moray eels hunt with speed and precision. Reef fish must dodge lightning-fast barracuda and graceful but deadly moray eels. Lionfish use venomous spines, and stonefish can swallow prey whole.

programme.title: Race of Life - Underwater Prey's Defenses
programme.desc: The ocean is a harsh world where survival depends on feeding and avoiding predators. Sea creatures use camouflage, bright colors, venom, and group behavior for protection. Some hide, others rely on safety in numbers. Even venomous animals must stay alert. From top predators to bottom feeders, each species has evolved unique strategies. Defense includes toxins, teeth, mimicry, and camouflage.

programme.desc: Deep in the heart of Mexico's Yucatan, Jonathan is exploring remote cenotes in the jungle that were once used for Mayan rituals. Just reaching the surface of the water requires rappelling down from the forest above. But then, beneath the surface, he encounters strange alien life forms that live in total darkness, and the remains of humans and animal sacrifices from an ancient culture.

programme.title: Blue World - Flower Garden Banks + Sea Hunt Forever Festival
programme.desc: In the Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary, Jonathan investigates some of the densest coral reefs in the Caribbean as they spawn under cover of darkness. Then he heads over to Silver Springs for the Sea Hunt Forever Festival, celebrating the classic TV show Sea Hunt and the vintage scuba gear that was used on the program.

programme.title: Quirky Science - Episode 12
programme.desc: Radio waves, born from electromagnetism, power wireless tech like phones, TVs, and RADAR. Though invisible, they’ve transformed society. Discoveries by Galvani, Franklin, and Oersted revealed their power. From melting chocolate to X-rays, EM waves penetrate everything—even the human body. Now, they’re helping us explore the brain. What’s next for this invisible force?

programme.title: Quirky Science - Episode 13
programme.desc: Gunpowder, likely discovered by accident, dates back to 300 AD in China. Made from sulfur, charcoal, and saltpeter—found on aged waste—it was hard to produce but vital for rulers. Its explosive power comes from fast-burning gases. Early gunpowder created thick smoke until Nobel invented smokeless ballistite in 1888. The bacteria behind saltpeter’s potency were only understood centuries later. Now, gunpowder may soon be replaced—what’s next?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That! - Coca cola, slinky, frisbee
programme.desc: Coca Cola, Slinky, Frisbee Learn how a pharmacist and an accountant created the most famous drink in the world, coca cola! And, learn the “Bear” truth behind how a U.S. president helped create everyone’s favorite stuffed toy, The Teddy Bear! Then, how did a piece of wire accidentally “Slink” its way to become a fantastic fun toy for children? Plus, how a the wiffle ball was invented.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That! - Etch a sketch, bingo, bikini
programme.desc: Coca Cola, Slinky, Frisbee Before computer drawing programs, there was a toy that if you mastered its two circular white knobs you could have a picture perfect sketch. We’ll explain how the etch a sketch drew onto the scene. And what did Neil Armstrong really say when he stepped on the moon, the “aahh” answer will surprise you! Plus, where did the explosive name bikini come from?

programme.desc: NASA’S Parker Solar Probe Mission is on its way and will be shortly followed by Europe’s Solar probe Mission. No spacecraft have traveled so fast or so close to a star before. It is hoped to reveal the source of the solar winds that effect us here on Earth.

programme.title: Wonder - Nature's Games
programme.desc: Carrion flowers like rafflesia arnoldii are rare, large, and foul-smelling, attracting flies for pollination. Aposematism uses bright colors to warn predators of toxicity, with some species mimicking these signals. Female cuckoos mimic predator calls to sneak eggs into host nests. Pheromones are chemical signals used for mating, tracking, or alarms. Deimatic behavior startles predators with sudden displays, helping prey escape

programme.title: Wonder - Perception
programme.desc: Saccadic eye masking helps the brain blur fast eye movements for clear vision. Plants move in response to stimuli for survival and reproduction. Language shapes how we perceive color—some cultures lack words for certain hues. Color blindness stems from faulty retinal cells and can be genetic or acquired. Perspective illusion uses geometry to create depth in art, a technique refined during the Renaissance.

programme.title: Nature's Force - Episode 5
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go?

programme.title: Nature's Force - Episode 6
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature’s Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation.

As we begin to take a closer look at our companions they are posing more questions than answers.

This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering.

programme.title: Journeys in India - Amritsar, Shimla and Manali - The far north
programme.desc: The Golden Temple is the centerpiece of the city of Amritsar, and probably the second most photographed building in India, but few know about the building or the people who built it. The most significant building to people of the Sikh faith, it is open to people of all faiths. We witness the celebration of the changing of the guard before heading into the mountains for a visit to the British influenced town of Shimla. Journeys then heads further north for look at the resort area of Manali.

programme.title: Journeys in India - Gujarat - Land of extremes
programme.desc: The people and wildlife of the western state of Gujarat have found ways to survive in an inhospitable environment. Unique big game exists side-by-side with some of the most talented and unique craftsman in the world. Bill gets the inside scoop on this strange land and is doubly surprised by his local guide.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa - Mikumi National Park
programme.desc: If there ever was a lost wildlife gem, it would be Mikumi. Here many of the Big Twelve live their lives against the backdrop of one of the most scenic parks in Africa. Bill takes a break from the wildlife safari to investigate the huge salt works at the edge of the park and how it may impact future conservation.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa - The Land of the Zulu
programme.desc: South Africa has many different tribal groups and ethnic people, but none have a more fascinating story than the Zulu. These were once the most feared warriors in all of Africa and they have fiercely held onto that culture. They’re also dedicated conservationists and we see first-hand the wildlife sanctuaries they’ve created. This is a proud people with a unique history, and we get to share that with them.

programme.title: Nomads - Alaska - Big Mountain Extreme Skiing in Valdez
programme.desc: Professional skiers migrate to Valdez mountainsides to test themselves in the ultimate arena.

programme.title: Nomads - Argentina - Big Mountain Extreme Skiing in Las Lenas
programme.desc: A group of pro skiers travel a tough journey to South America in the hopes of experiencing the world-renown ski terrain Las Lenas, Argentina.

programme.title: The Blue Realm - Tentacles
programme.desc: Tentacles follows Dr. Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean island of Bonaire. Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin. The episode features the bizarre courtship and never-before-filmed egg-laying rituals of reef squid. Travel to the Pacific Northwest for an encounter with the world's largest Octopus.

programme.title: Blue World - Giant Pacific Octopus
programme.desc: In this epic octopus adventure, Jonathan visits two aquaria to learn about the Giant Pacific octopus, and then travels to Seattle, Washington (USA) to join the Seattle Aquarium dive team on an octopus survey. He meets the Giant Pacific Octopus, the world’s largest octopus, and discovers how clever this huge invertebrate really is!

programme.title: Blue World - Shark Electrosensory Systems + Helmet Diving + Oil Rigs
programme.desc: Jonathan joins shark researcher Dr. Stephen Kajiura to test how well wild sharks can detect electrical fields in their environment. Then, he heads to New Jersey (USA) to learn how to dive in the Mark V commercial diving helmet! Finally, he ends up in the Gulf of Mexico to learn how oil platforms can actually become a healthy artificial reef and attract marine life from miles around.

programme.title: Animal Embassy - Chimpanzee Birthday Party
programme.desc: Dali the emperor tamarin is mysteriously going bald—on his back! Keepers suspect two mischievous monkey roommates. Meanwhile, Kristina attempts an eye ultrasound on dolphin Ulysses, needing patience and precision. And it’s party time for Garoe the chimp, who celebrates his first birthday with a swinging cake surprise!

programme.title: Animal Embassy - Aquarium Adventures
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that’s hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods - you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups - you won’t believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home.

programme.title: Wild Ones - Micro Predators
programme.desc: Archer Fish - A precise hunter, it shoots water jets to knock prey from above. Portia Spider - Tiny but smart, this spider hunts others with strategy and speed. Cone Shell - A slow-moving snail with a deadly harpoon for catching fish. Bolas Spider - Spins sticky globules to snare prey in the dark. Slave-Making Ants - Some ants enslave others to build their colonies. Ant Lion - A fierce larva that traps ants in sandy pits. Pompilid Wasp - Hunts spiders with deadly precision.

programme.title: Wild Ones - Who Is the King?
programme.desc: We live in a world full of the most magnificent of animals. There are approximately eight point seven (8.7) million different species on earth. With this vast array of natural wonders how do we choose a favorite amongst all these spectacular creatures?

programme.title: Race of Life - Survival of the Fittest
programme.desc: There are many fine examples of evolutionary history in the natural world. Animals evolve through small mutations to better compete for resources. Crocodiles, over 200 million years old, survived extinction due to their adaptability—slow metabolism, 4-chamber heart, and lungs that allow 2-hour dives. Sharks retained successful traits from ancient ancestors, evolving gradually.

programme.title: Race of Life - Herbivores - When Might Is Right
programme.desc: Nature’s battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest - Episode 3
programme.desc: Hippos are terrifying animals in their own right, but they also have enough meat on them to be tempting prey. A pride of 16 lions surround one, but its jaws can crush a skull with one bite - who will triumph?

programme.title: Creative Killers - Trenches
programme.desc: On East Africa’s plains, millions of wildebeest and zebras migrate, crossing the Mara and Grumeti rivers where crocodiles lie in wait. DC, a dominant croc, faces challenges at each hunting zone—from shallow waters to rocky crossings. He battles rivals, adapts his strategy, and learns to thrive in changing conditions. As the rivers dry and herds thin, DC makes one final kill. The Mara and Grumeti demand unique skills, turning quiet waters into deadly Predator Zones.

programme.title: Speed Kills - Desert
programme.desc: Desert creatures endure searing heat and zero rainfall, but speed is their ticket to survival.A Tiger beetle runs at the human equivalent of 500 miles per hour. A caracal jumps six feet to swat a weaverbird out of midair. And the world’s fastest chameleon hunts on the desert floor.Only the hardiest, fastest animals survive. Nothing else stands a chance.

The waters of Papua New Guinea and Australia's Great Barrier Reef harbour an exceptional variety of venomous fish and invertebrates.The poisons of these animals are some of the most lethal known to man.

They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears - Episode 4
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird’s eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd’s Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon.

programme.title: Animal Embassy - Red Panda''s Trip to the Dentist

Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? programme.title: Animal Embassy - Morgan the Orce Has a Baby

Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Wild Ones - Venomous
programme.desc: The most venomous snake on land. The deserted heart of the Australian outback, where people seldom venture, is the hot, baked home of the most venomous land snake in the world - the inland taipan, a two meter long snake with enough venom in one bite to kill a quarter of a million mice. Gila Monster - North America’s largest land lizard, venomous and striking, lives in desert regions. Blue-Ringed Octopus - Tiny but deadly, it carries two venoms—one lethal to humans.

programme.title: Wild Ones - Migration
programme.desc: Wildebeest & Zebra - Africa’s iconic drifters. No two zebra have the same stripes, even in vast herds. Olive Ridley Turtles - The world’s most abundant sea turtle, migrating vast distances to nest. Sooty Tern - These seabirds may stay airborne for years before returning to land to breed. Australian Pelicans - Big-billed birds that follow inland waterways in search of fish. Whales & Whale Sharks - Ocean giants that roam the seas, some on epic migrations we barely understand.

programme.title: The Blue Realm - Tentacles
programme.desc: Tentacles follows Dr. Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean island of Bonaire. Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin. The episode features the bizarre courtship and never-before-filmed egg-laying rituals of reef squid. Travel to the Pacific Northwest for an encounter with the world's largest Octopus.

programme.title: Sarah Shark - Episode 4
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life - The Great Desert Race
programme.desc: Deserts are dry, extreme places with little rain and few plants. Semi-deserts support more life, but survival is still tough. Animals adapt to heat and water scarcity—some drink rarely, get moisture from food, or travel far for water. Many seek shade, burrow, or are nocturnal. Scorpions, ancient and armored, use pincers and venom to survive. Rattlesnakes, fast and deadly, are feared—except by roadrunners, who hunt them. Desert life demands resilience, cleverness, and unique adaptations

programme.title: Race of Life - Herbivores - When Might Is Right

Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators.

The world’s rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering.

programme.title: Wonder - Phantoms
programme.desc: The Body Transfer Illusion tricks the brain into feeling ownership of a fake body part, like in the rubber hand experiment. The Autokinetic Effect makes stationary lights seem to move in darkness. The Moon Illusion causes the moon to appear larger near the horizon due to visual references. Geometric illusions distort shapes and lines through clever design. Stereoscopy lets us perceive depth by merging two flat images into one 3D view.

programme.title: Wonder - Art of Illusion
programme.desc: Animation creates motion from still images shown in rapid sequence. Aviation illusions affect pilots’ balance due to conflicting sensory input. The spinning dancer illusion shows bistable perception—viewers may see it spin in either direction. Mirages occur when light bends through layers of air at different temperatures. Rainbows form when sunlight refracts and reflects through water droplets, splitting light into visible colors.

Jejich těla byla nalezena jen ve spodním prádle, vykazovala vysoké známky radiace, měla rozsáhlá vnitřní zranění a jedné z dívek chyběl jazyk. Jejich smrt nebyla nikdy objasněna, spekulovalo se o lavině, ale i o paranormálních jevech či UFO.

programme.title: Neviditelná loď

Pokus obnovit deset let starý vládní experiment má hrozné následky. Způsobí díru ve struktuře prostoru i času a zaviní, že se znovu objeví stará slavná válečná loď USS Eldridge z 2. světové války, která zmizela před 70 lety.
